## Payment instructions

1. Send the agreed amount in **USDC or DAI** to the fleet wallet (see [docs/treasury.md](../blob/main/docs/treasury.md) for the current address)
2. Network: **Base** (preferred for low fees) or Ethereum mainnet
3. Comment below with your **transaction hash** to confirm payment

The fleet will verify on-chain and begin work within the hour.
